record.paper_title: Open Problems in Constructive Function Theory
record.original_question: Let w be a weight on [-1,1], let μ_w be its equilibrium measure, and let ω be the density of μ_w where it exists. Kuijlaars showed that if ω(x) is comparable to |x|^{-A} near 0 for some A>0 and if w^n p_n converges uniformly on [-1,1] for polynomials p_n of degree n, then the limit function must vanish at 0. Does the same conclusion still follow under the weaker lower bound ω(x) ≳ |x|^{-A} near 0?

evidence.quote: Kuijlaars showed that if ω(x) ∼ |x|^{-A} ... then f must vanish at 0. Show this if only ω(x) ≥ c |x|^{-A} is true.
Since the conference there has been some progress: My student Péter Várjú has proved a theorem that includes the solution as a special case [38].

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $w:[-1,1]	o[0,\infty)$ be an admissible weight (continuous, with $w>0$ on a set of positive capacity), and let $\mu_w$ denote its equilibrium measure, i.e. the unique probability measure on $[-1,1]$ minimizing the weighted logarithmic energy $\int\!\!\int \log rac{1}{|x-y|}\,d\mu(x)\,d\mu(y) + 2\int Q\,d\mu$, where $Q=-\log w$. Assume that $\mu_w$ is absolutely continuous in a neighborhood of $0$ and write $\omega(x)=d\mu_w/dx$ for its density there.

Suppose there exist constants $A>0$, $c>0$, and $\delta>0$ such that
$$\omega(x)\;\ge\;c\,|x|^{-A}\qquad	ext{for all }x\in[-\delta,\delta]\setminus\{0\}.$$
Let $(p_n)_{n\ge 1}$ be a sequence of polynomials with $\deg p_n\le n$ such that the sequence of weighted polynomials $w^n p_n$ converges uniformly on $[-1,1]$ to a function $f:[-1,1]	o\mathbb{R}$.

Prove or disprove: under these hypotheses one must have $f(0)=0$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is reported as resolved: a theorem of P. Várjú on weighted polynomial approximation includes this lower-bound density version as a special case, yielding the vanishing $f(0)=0$ under the weaker assumption $\omega(x)\gtrsim |x|^{-A}$.

status_evidence.title: Várjú, Approximation by polynomials with varying weights
status_evidence.snippet: Várjú establishes results on approximation by weighted polynomials w^n p_n, generalizing Kuijlaars-type vanishing theorems under lower bounds on the equilibrium density.
status_evidence.claim: Várjú's theorem covers the lower-bound density case and implies the desired vanishing at 0.
